scope: Actual gas transport with old-density/old-force and new-density/new-force half sources, common hierarchy timestep and fixed native topology. Independent source-field snapshots and per-leaf momentum/kinetic-work accounting. Thermal cases additionally reconcile original cooling/heating, initial temperature clipping and complete AMR call budgets.
limits: Noncosmological periodic smooth gas at one spatial resolution and short endpoint. Cooling uses a level-local Lie split, not demonstrated second-order full physics. Optional particles are fixed-mass numerical controls with synchronized endpoint checks. No total QUMOND field-plus-gas energy conservation, exact self-force cancellation, stellar/AGN feedback, enrichment, MPI/regrid/restart or galaxy-formation readiness.
